summary: Learn programme budgeting, costing, and performance reporting in 5 days. Build practical tools for stronger allocations and accountability.
lede: Performance-focused programme budgeting connects resources with activities, outputs, outcomes and indicators. For professionals preparing, reviewing or monitoring public finance budgets, the course covers building programme structures, calculating full costs, setting targets and analysing execution variances. It also develops skills in budget justification, dashboard monitoring and performance reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, justify, monitor, or report on programme budgets and performance results in public finance environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of public budgeting, financial reporting, and programme planning. Familiarity with Excel-based budget analysis, performance indicators, and basic cost concepts will help you apply the exercises more quickly. No coding is required, although experience using spreadsheets, budget templates, or reporting dashboards is useful. The course is pitched at an advanced level, so it assumes you already work with budget preparation, monitoring, or performance reporting in a finance, planning, or programme role.
